title: rosa sempervirens f. prostrata
intro: Rosa sempervirens f. prostrata, commonly known as the trailing rose, is a fragrant, evergreen flowering plant that is a low-growing, spreading variety of the Rosa sempervirens species. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as colds, fever, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa sempervirens f. prostrata include its ability to act as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, helping to relieve respiratory and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
